title: Human civilization as a cargo cult from an ancient contact event

tellings.quote: concept. So our concept in starting this project was that our entire society is a cargo cult because everything we're trying to do

plain: Our whole civilization, the writer Peter Levenda suggests, may be a cargo cult, like island peoples who copied the trappings of visitors' technology, left over from an ancient contact with beings from elsewhere. Levenda tells Michels this was the starting idea of the book Sekret Machines: Gods, which he wrote with Tom DeLonge: "our entire society is a cargo cult because everything we're trying to do" goes back to that contact.
